Transport Documents

ใบรับรองสุขภาพ

An official document issued by an authorized body certifying that products, especially food or animals, comply with health and safety regulations for international trade.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An official document issued by an authorized body certifying that products, especially food or animals, comply with health and safety regulations for international trade.

Operational example

A valid health certificate must accompany all meat exports to ensure compliance with importing country regulations.
